methods.seasonality: Calendar-month medians after preliminary seasonal Sen detrending; centered climatology
methods.ci: 199 circular residual block bootstraps, block=12 months, seed=2026
methods.significance: Hamed-Rao modified Mann-Kendall on complete annual deseasonalized means; lags 1..3; alpha=.05

warnings: Exploratory association only; trends do not establish causation.

Single-point sample is not an Arctic regional assessment.

Legacy provenance observations means genuine source data; data_kind specifies reanalysis.
